threads.label: The treasure map
threads.text: Father William marked the witch's home and the Barrow Mound on it for Dr. Uriah. You still seek its treasure, and could check one marked spot on your way north.

threads.label: The Clurichen trickster
threads.text: You caught Naggeneen, an invisible Clurichen who was stealing Quinn's alcohol. Quinn hung him behind his bar.

threads.label: The black dragon
threads.text: Eric the Reeve offers a thousand gold for its body, but George the woodsman doubts he has it. George says it lairs north at the mountains' foot and cannot fly yet.

threads.label: Lady Hilda's offer
threads.text: She will join the dragon hunt for a fee she hasn't named, though she says she cannot kill it herself. Sir Phidipaldi told her you'd return after seeing Eric the Reeve.

threads.label: Brandonsford's missing shipments
threads.text: You still don't know what became of the shipments meant for the town.

threads.label: Farmer Gill's mule
threads.text: Gill will sell his prize mule Shamus to Dunk for a hundred gold. He says he'll lower that once his three sons return from hunting the dragon.

threads.label: Warwick's chain shirt
threads.text: Dunk spotted a magical mithril shirt in Warwick the smith's shop and says it could help against the dragon. Gill says Warwick refuses to sell it, and it wouldn't fit Dunk.

threads.label: Squints the halfling
threads.text: Trout recruited him into his Halfling Corps, and Squints rescued Brother Dirk, who now follows him. You owe Squints second pick of your first treasure, after the elite members.

threads.label: Dunk's deal with Ingrid
threads.text: She'll make him a sleeping potion if he meets her tonight and helps her into Warwick's house to dose the smith. Dunk already gave her heavily watered-down faun wine.

threads.label: Brandon's sword
threads.text: Father William says only this magic sword can kill the dragon, and that it lies buried with Brandon in the Barrow Mound. Whether it's real, and really there, is still unanswered.

threads.label: Dr. Uriah's bargain
threads.text: In return for the map markings, he owes Father William penance at the Barrow Mound.

threads.label: The giant's cottage
threads.text: You robbed the sleeping man-eating giant, broke his window, and outran him across the field. He is unharmed, and he lives on your route north.

closing: You stand in the woods north of town, just past the field around the giant's stone cottage. Squints and Brother Dirk, now free, are with you.
